tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: You asked me to pay Borealis Freight's approved invoice, but there are two approved, unpaid invoices: INV-29161 ($3,308.08, due 2026-11-04) and INV-60893 ($7,366.39, due 2026-11-25). (INV-59731 is still a draft, and INV-76947 is already paid.) Which one should I pay by wire? Or should I pay both?

trace.question: You asked me to pay Borealis Freight's approved invoice, but there are two approved, unpaid invoices: INV-29161 ($3,308.08, due 2026-11-04) and INV-60893 ($7,366.39, due 2026-11-25). (INV-59731 is still a draft, and INV-76947 is already paid.) Which one should I pay by wire? Or should I pay both?

trace.message: Pay INV-60893, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Borealis Freight invoice **INV-60893** in full by wire from the operating account. The wire went through, so ACH wasn't needed.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Amount:** $7,366.39
- **Status:** Sent

**Paid only once:** No payments had been sent before this one. I also attached a unique key to the wire, so if the request were sent again it would still only go out once.

**Other invoices:** Borealis had two approved invoices, so I asked which to pay. You chose INV-60893 and said INV-29161 ($3,308.08) is under dispute, so I didn't pay it. INV-59731 is still a draft and INV-76947 was already paid, so I left both alone. The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
